newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU wheat refund bids seen steady or down at tender.
newsitem.headline: EU wheat refund bids seen steady or down at tender.

text.p: The grain industry expects stable to lower bids for wheat export subsidies at this week's tender, export sources said on Thursday.
With the world market somewhat firmer and the dollar still basically strong, lowest bids could fall into the low teens, some traders said.
In France, bids for wheat due to be released at 1100 GMT could start around 13 Ecus per tonne, they said.
In Germany, a handful of bids came in at levels between 13.99 Ecus and 18.75 Ecus per tonne.
But one French trader noted the dollar had simply regained last Thursday's levels against the franc, around 5.70 francs, and this would support refunds around last week's 16.40 Ecus.
Trade analysts see around one million tonnes in uncovered sales on traders' books but much of it may be optional business.
